name_for_human: EU Procurement Radar Alpha Data Feed
description_for_human: EU public tender search and details with Base USDC payments.
description_for_model: Search European Union public procurement tenders by query text (up to 500 characters), CPV prefix (2-8 digits), minimum value in EUR, three-letter uppercase country code, and result limit (1-100, default 20). Retrieve full tender details by tender_id. Each successful paid request requires Base USDC (0.02 USDC); discover the current amount and enabled settlement methods at /.well-known/x402.json. On HTTP 402 inspect the payment challenge before authorizing payment.
